goal: Let pruned node operators index transactions without storing the entire blockchain
Return candidate block hashes so callers can fetch pruned blocks on demand
agreement: Strong concept support for indexing transactions on storage-constrained nodes (ajtowns, arejula27)
Settled objection around building a partial index on already-pruned nodes (mzumsande)
Settled concern by returning candidate block hashes in structured error data (arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it lifts a long-standing incompatibility between transaction indexing and pruning
Disk-constrained node operators can now query historical transactions locally

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because lookup endpoints now return candidate block hashes when blocks are pruned
Clients can use the returned hashes to fetch missing blocks programmatically
